avis.titre: Gimme That Perf Korean SKIN!Gimme That Perf Korean SKIN!
avis.texte: Okay skincare lovers—these Toner Pads are seriously underrated. I’ve been using them daily for about 2 weeks now and my skin has never felt this calm, clear, and balanced. First of all—ZERO scent. No fragrance. No essential oils. No drama. Just pure, hydrating goodness. Sensitive-skin babes, this is the toner pad of your dreams. 🌱 The texture is super soft (no scratchy cotton here), and they’re soaked in this watery carrot-extract formula that calms redness and gives my skin the softest glow. Perfect after cleansing or whenever your skin is feeling a little “why am I like this?” Why I’m obsessed: 🥕 Packed with antioxidant-rich carrot + beta carotene 💧 Light, watery hydration—no sticky residue 🧖‍♀️ Skin feels soothed, plump, and clean 🧊 Fridge-friendly for an extra calming boost - P.S. You can peel each pad in half for double the product. (shown in picture) Why 4 Star? - Wish there was MORE Product for the price No breakouts. No irritation. No scent. Just happy skin. If you’ve been looking for calming toner pads that actually do what they say—this is it. Soft skin, strong barrier, clean ingredients.

The product is fine but in my opinion toners are not worth the price. I have sensitive skin and it flares up easily, but I can’t say if this makes any difference, at least not obvious. Another thing is that if you’re already using a moisturizer adding a toner doesn’t do much, at least for me I can’t see the point of it. I like that it feels like using a face mask but that’s mainly it. If you want to save money I don’t think you need this, sometimes I forget it in my desk.

I really like the hydration this product gives to my skin. It doesn’t feel greasy or heavy, and it has never caused any irritation or bad reactions, even though I have sensitive skin with acne, rosacea, and allergies. I do like this product, but I personally wouldn’t recommend it for daily use because over-exfoliating the skin with these types of products is not always the best idea, especially for sensitive skin.

I’m a makeup and skincare junkie and this is one of the only toner pads I have ever repurchased. I love using this in the morning before my AM skincare and makeup routine. It sits well under makeup and adds a nice glow to my skin. For reference, I have dry skin with an oily tzone.
Love these toner pads! So soothing and refreshing. They make my skin non-greasy and soft. The value for money is great since they come in good quantity.

These toner pads are amazing! They’re thick, enough to be split into three. They have a slight scent that smells refreshing. It calms down the skin and feels very cooling! I noticed calmer and brighter skin when using this product

These pads are awsome! I unfortunately have to wax due to excessive facial hair which leaves my face red and feeling likes its on fire! I use these pads where ever I waxed and it immediately soothes my skin and takes away all the redness and any inflammation I may have due to the waxing. I 100% recommend it! You will not be disappointed! 😉
This skincare product is very good. It is mild but hydrates the skin
It feels like I am actually pampering my skin with nutrients. The light natural aroma is divine. The skin feels cleaner and plump after use. Very soothing

avis.titre: 思った以上に良かった
avis.texte: 気に入ったのでリピート 乾燥肌気味で合わないと吹き出物が出るタイプですが、刺激も匂いもなく使いやすいです さっぱりめですがすぐ乾燥することもなく、フラットに潤います 化粧水を手早く塗布したく使ってみましたが、とても便利で自分には合っていました 通常の化粧水は面倒に感じていましたが、こちらはパッドで軽く顔全体に馴染ませたあと半分に割いて頬にペッと乗せて、その間に服を着ればパックしている状態になるので楽ちんです パックがしっかりしているので割きやすいですし、コットンが変に伸びたりしません パッドのものは肌への摩擦が懸念でしたが、1枚1枚がすごく化粧水たっぷりなので肌への負担が気にならず、パックしたあともカスカスになっていないです 今1つ目がほぼ使い終わるところですが、最後まで化粧水しみしみです 肌の調子が上がる等のすごい効果はとくに感じませんが、しっかりケアがしやすいので結果スキンケアがちゃんと出来てめんどくさがりな自分には良い商品です

Ottimi pads! Li sto usando ogni giorno come impacco. Le istruzioni sono ben scritte, ogni pad vale per due perché si possono dividere se li si vuole usare come impacco... talmente buoni che quasi è un dispiacere isarli passandoli solo sul viso per poi buttarli via... lasciati in posa sul viso (fino a quando non si asciugano) danno il loro meglio, soprattutto su pelli arrossate o irritate! Lo ricomprerò sicuramente!

avis.titre: Another Korean skincare win! So soothing after a microneedling session and great for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I love these water pads. I first saw them at an Olive Young store in Seoul, South Korea on my most recent visit there and I wanted to purchase them then, but my luggage was already at full capacity with all of the other Korean skincare and cosmetic goodies I'd purchased, so I was thrilled to see them being sold on Amazon. I have sensitive skin and these have been dermatologically tested and deemed safe for sensitive skin and I concur because they have caused me no irritation, but they do have a scent and I think it's just lovely. The appeal (or disgust) of a scent is highly individualized, but I personally love this one and more than carrot, I smell the sage notes and just a bit of lavender. Sometimes, I don't want to wear a full mask of product or I just have a couple of areas that need a little extra attention and care and these fit the bill. They are thick and can be split in two, so a jar of 60 is more like 120 and they actually adhere better when split. Keep in mind they're not precut to be split, so sometimes you'll see more pad on one side than the other, but it doesn't affect the end result. I'd absolutely buy these again.

I thought it was working great until it started breaking me out a few days after. The photo I’m sharing is after I stopped using a few days so the acne is a little bit better. But I’ve gotten huge pimples. I was hoping that it would work, but it’s just too much essential oil for me.

avis.titre: Calms my irritation in a few seconds
avis.texte: This Toner Pad effectively soothes irritation and reduces redness. It can be used as one or two pads and is full of toner that delivers on its promise.

avis.titre: Feels super soothing on your skin!
avis.texte: This is my favorite product in my skincare routine. I've struggled with hyperpigmentation for years, and I feel like this product has helped reduce a lot of my redness. I put one pad on each of my cheeks for ~10 minutes every night after I've cleansed and dried my face, and it feels so cooling on my skin. It's like a mini face mask that I use everyday.
It is very helpful to calm sensitive skins. A pad is thick enough to split by two. If you are looking for a daily toner pad, get this one.
This item came 90% empty and used with no seal! Really disgusting.
